newsitem.title: GREECE: Merrill Lynch issues new OTE call warrants.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch issues new OTE call warrants.

text.p: Merrill Lynch International issued a new drachma-denominated call spread warrants on OTE telecom with Sigma Securities and National Securities as lead managers, it said on Wednesday.
A total of 750,000 European-style call warrants were issued June 18 and mature December 16, 1998. They are out-of-the-money with the strike price set at 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000.
The instruments are cash settled and cleared through Euroclear/Cedel. They will be listed on the London Stock Exchange.
The minimum trading lot is 500 warrants. One warrant controls one share of underlying OTE.
The warrants were quoted at 1,202-1,262 drachmas on Wednesday based on a reference price for OTE of 6,615 drachmas.
